answer: Dawn Sensor Proof: each identity must file, at local dawn, a signed ambient-light and temperature curve from a tamper-evident sensor at its claimed mesa site, matching the public weather record for that spot. Faking one curve costs 6 hours of live capture per identity, so a 1,000-fake farm burns 6,000 sensor-hours per dawn and still fails the cross-check: peers compare the curve against the mesa record, and any mismatch voids the identity and its nectar reward for the epoch.
